[[Adeil zu Heltzer]] is a member of [[Kurzick]] [[Great House]] of [[House zu Heltzer (Great House)|House zu Heltzer]] family.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|House zu Heltzer}}

==Dialogue==
:''"As you know, when The [[Jade Wind]] blew across the land two hundred years ago, it's magical energy infused itself into the land, creating powerful deposits we now extract. Out on [[the Jade Sea]] this energy was trapped in the very jade itself, while here in the [[Echovald Forest|Echovald]], it has manifested as amber. Combined, the [[Jadeite Shard|Jade]] and [[Amber Chunk|Amber]] enable us to do many things. The [[juggernaut]]s you see are just one example of what can be accomplished by using both resources. Without amber and jade, the [[Kurzick]] way of life would be no more."''
